title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Activity
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Activity. The activity of a patient/user, i.e. daily and nocturnal activities (ttl rdfs:comment). Superclass of DailyActivity and NocturnalActivity (both zero-own-property candidates that inherit activityDuration and velocity from here). Activity is the range of HealthActor.hasActivity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Activity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

activityDuration.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/activityDuration'. The duration of an activity, in seconds. ttl-confirmed, domain Activity, range xsd:float (s4ehaw:activityDuration).

velocity.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Velocity'. The velocity of a moving entity, typically expressed in m/s. The source ttl declares s4ehaw:Velocity as an undomained saref:Property individual (no rdfs:domain); attached here to Activity as the best-fitting class (e.g. the speed of a walking or running activity).
